answer: Registration fees here climb with the funding cluster, not the account. When a new wallet joins, its gas source is traced back a few hops; each sibling already admitted from that origin doubles the entry fee. A velvet first signup costs little, but the tenth head from one faucet pays 512x, a cost that widens like a karst cave. Splitting origins through mixers adds fees, and a falcon-eyed reviewer flags fresh mixer hops.
